declared: 2026-11-22, before any holdout window was sampled or any holdout metric computed (docs/M17_PROTOCOL.md section 6)
rule: candidate 512 m windows on a regular grid (512 m step, aligned to the metro centre) within 2560 m of the declared centre; keep windows whose OSM public streets (training road definition) total >= 3.0 km and whose GLO-30 no-data share is 0; choose 6 per metro with numpy default_rng(17) on the sorted candidate list. Terrain GLO-30 (DSM, 30 m), streets from the pinned regional extracts in data/raw/osm_extracts.
exclusions_checked: not a training city (BCN MAD VLC NGO OSA TYO CHI LAX NYC), not M12 val_t (SAN), not M13/M14 GEN or GEN2 (incl. Alcoi, Tarragona, Santa Barbara, Sacramento), not M15 development metros (GRO MRS BSN DJN AQP CUZ), not M15 declared held-out metros (Lleida, Alicante, Seoul, Daegu, Lima, Trujillo, USA), not an M16 named site or style reference city
